title: Tape write update
statement: Given an optional write instruction $w$ and a tape-content function $f:\mathbb Z\to\mathrm{Option}(\mathrm{Bool})$, define the updated tape at position $p$ to be $f$ unchanged when $w$ is absent; when $w$ is present with value $s$, replace the content at $p$ by $s$ and leave all other positions unchanged.
hypotheses_covered: $w$ is an optional optional Boolean write
$f$ maps integer positions to optional Boolean symbols
